text.name: The Divine Story of Khatu Shyam Ji

Baba Shyam, worshipped as Khatu Shyam Ji, is believed to be the incarnation of Barbarika, the brave grandson of Bhima from the Mahabharata. Renowned for his unmatched courage, humility, and devotion, Barbarika willingly sacrificed his head before the Kurukshetra war upon Lord Krishna's request.

Pleased by this supreme sacrifice, Lord Krishna granted him the divine blessing that in Kaliyuga he would be worshipped as Shyam, and devotees remembering him with sincere faith would receive his blessings.
Today, millions visit Khatu every year seeking peace, hope, strength, and divine grace.
Barbarika was born to Ghatotkacha and Ahilavati. From childhood he displayed exceptional bravery and dedication toward righteousness.
Through intense penance, he received three infallible arrows and a divine bow from Lord Shiva.
Before the Mahabharata war, he vowed to always support the weaker side. Recognizing the consequences of this promise, Lord Krishna tested him and eventually requested his head as an offering.
Without hesitation, Barbarika accepted, demonstrating the highest form of devotion and sacrifice. His severed head was placed on a hill from where he witnessed the entire Mahabharata war.
"In Kaliyuga, you shall be worshipped as Shyam — and those who remember you with sincerity shall receive your blessings." — Lord Krishna
From a warrior's birth to eternal divine grace - the sacred story of Baba Shyam.
Born to Ghatotkacha and Ahilavati, Barbarika came into the world with extraordinary strength and divine purpose.
Through intense penance and devotion, Barbarika received the blessings and training of Lord Shiva himself.
Lord Shiva bestowed upon him three infallible arrows - each capable of destroying entire armies single-handedly.
Before the Kurukshetra war, Barbarika encountered Lord Krishna who tested his resolve and wisdom.
When Krishna requested his head as an offering, Barbarika unhesitatingly gave it - an act of ultimate devotion.
His severed head was placed on a hill from where he witnessed the entire Mahabharata war as promised by Krishna.
Lord Krishna declared Barbarika would be worshipped as Shyam in Kaliyuga and millions would be blessed by his grace.
Sacred values and virtues that guide millions on the path of righteous living.
True devotion brings peace, strength, and divine grace in every moment of life.
Remain humble regardless of power or position — greatness lies in simplicity.
Selfless service and giving without expectation is the highest virtue.
Open your heart and help those who are in need — see the divine in every being.
Walk the path of righteousness and let truth be your guiding light.
Serve everyone without discrimination — all are equal in the eyes of Baba Shyam.
Serving humanity is the truest and highest form of serving God himself.
The Divine Abode of Baba Shyam

The sacred Khatu Shyam Temple is located in Khatu village, Sikar district, Rajasthan. According to tradition, Baba Shyam's divine head was discovered at this location and later enshrined by the local king following divine guidance.
Over the centuries, the temple has become one of India's most revered pilgrimage destinations, welcoming millions of devotees every year.
Especially during the annual Falgun Mela, when devotees gather from across the world to seek Baba Shyam's blessings, the temple transforms into a magnificent ocean of faith and devotion.
